<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application and supporting documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa application decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent representation office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Application decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_Start" name="Start planning"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Split" name="Organize in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accommodation" name="Negotiate and organize accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BankAccount" name="Negotiate and organize bank account"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Authorization" name="Handle visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further cycle is due at the stated interval of x months</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_VisaCycleStart" name="Start authorization cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineAuthority" name="Determine competent issuing authority">
        <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases they may be issued at certain border control posts or, where visa extension is permitted, by the state police headquarters. For Schengen visas, use the representation office for the main travel destination. If stays in several countries are equal, determine the main destination from the length and purpose of the stays; if it cannot be determined, use the country of first entry into the Schengen area. For category A and C visas, territorial competence is based on the consular district of the applicant's legal residence. A representation office may exceptionally accept a legally resident applicant not registered in its district if the applicant justifies the choice. Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence or centre of interest, verifiable by documents such as registration forms, residence permits or visas. Consult the BMEIA representation-office directory for addresses, hours and local requirements. Confirm the applicable route for a Rot-Weiss-Rot Card with the competent Austrian representation.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareRequirements" name="Prepare visa application and required evidence">
        <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the visa application form; a travel document valid in Austria, issued within the last ten years, with at least two empty pages and validity exceeding the visa duration by at least three months; a compliant 35 x 45 mm portrait passport photo; fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned stay, covering at least 30,000 Euro throughout the Schengen area; proof of sufficient means for the stay and return journey; and other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, which may vary by location. Check for other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance for information"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocs" name="Prepare any additional requested documents"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocs" name="Continue with available documents"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Is there another ground for refusal?"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_RefusalGround" name="Do not proceed: refusal ground"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
      <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive application decision">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Decision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
      </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_VisaCycleEnd" name="Application decision received"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisaStart_Authority" sourceRef="Event_VisaCycleStart" targetRef="Task_DetermineAuthority"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Authority_Prepare" sourceRef="Task_DetermineAuthority" targetRef="Task_PrepareRequirements"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_Additional" sourceRef="Task_PrepareRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalRequested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Additional documents are requested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_PrepareAdditional" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditional_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalDocs" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_RefusalCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGround" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Event_RefusalGround">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A ground for refusal is present</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefusalGround" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No other ground for refusal is present</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDecision"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_End" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Event_VisaCycleEnd"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join" name="Accommodation, bank and authorization steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_End" name="Planning steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="Event_Start" targetRef="Gateway_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Authorization" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="SubProcess_Authorization"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_Join" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Join" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Authorization_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_Authorization" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Event_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
